**How the capture went through the product**

Starting from the page after sign-in, it opened menu items, tabs and links. 6 screenshots taken.

It stopped at the limit of 6 screenshots a run. 21 links and buttons it found were not tried yet; many lead to screens already captured. To try them, run again with the Continue link in Continue From.

**Not clicked**

- **Buttons and dialogs:** not opened. Choose "Buttons and dialogs" to capture them.
- **Would change data, so not pressed:** Launch sample course. Choose "Also press buttons that change data" to include them.
- **Never pressed:** Sign out. Signing out, paying and acting as another user are never done.
- **On another site, so not followed:** Vendor docs
- **Sorting, paging, carousel and calendar controls, not clicked (they show the same screen):** 16
- **The same button on each item of a list, opened for the first item only:** Actions (4 more)

**Opened, but not kept**

- **The same as a screen already captured, so not kept again:** 1

**Check these screenshots**

- Plans — The page looked empty when it was captured. Check this image.

**Other requests the pages made**

The pages also sent 2 requests that were not plain reads (searches, tracking, loading data), as they do for anyone using them. These went through; nothing in their address or content said they change data:

- POST /api/track
